name: Underwater Swim Fix (MC-220390)
statusMeaning: Calls something that is on Kiln's roadmap. Parts of it may already run.
author: bikerboys
description: Fixes the bug where if you hit an entity while swimming and holding the sprint hotkey, the server will think that you are not swimming anymore, while the client does. resulting in weird behavior.
evidence: Server-side mod: Kiln runs mods' code on Horizon's single-player server, not on dedicated servers.
